question.prompt: Which single requirement below is mentioned in BOTH Text 1 and Text 2?

stimulus.title: Two Notes About the Excursion
stimulus.body: Text 1 — From the class newsletter: 'Next Tuesday, Year 5 will travel to the Riverside Wildlife Centre. Students must wear full school uniform, bring a labelled water bottle, and arrive at school by 8:15 am sharp, as the bus departs at 8:30 am. Please pack a nut-free lunch, since the centre has a strict allergy policy.' Text 2 — From a note sent home by Ms Whitlock: 'A reminder that our wildlife centre excursion is happening soon. Please make sure your child has closed-in shoes, since parts of the reserve are quite muddy at this time of year, and a labelled water bottle. Morning tea will be provided by the centre, so students do not need to bring their own.'

question.explanation: Text 1 asks students to 'bring a labelled water bottle' and Text 2 separately repeats 'a labelled water bottle', so this requirement genuinely appears in both texts. School uniform and a nut-free lunch are mentioned only in Text 1, and closed-in shoes are mentioned only in Text 2. So only the labelled water bottle requirement is confirmed by both texts together.
